_meta.title: Underkeep entity stats by level

units.gold: whole gold coins; runtime stores hundredths

notes: Five entity tiers; visitor rest rooms I–IV and staff rest rooms I–III are defined.
A floor-group level is its structural tier, not its floor number. Each floor group contains five floors.
Equal min/max values indicate fixed values. Initial mob spawners have no separate price; the floor installation order costs 5 gold.
No research descriptions, unlock state or asset specifications are stored in this file.
Research unlocks reference this file using statsPath JSON pointers.

statSemantics.defense: depleting shield pool, blue above red health
statSemantics.primary: strength, mana or divinity; consumable current resource separate from permanent maximum
statSemantics.xpPerStatPoint: higher means slower learning; not a beneficial learning-rate multiplier
statSemantics.researchTier: content tier, distinct from skill-point gains
statSemantics.resourceRecovery: Quiet outside rooms: 0.5 points/game hour; room tiers I/II/III/IV recover 2/3/4/5 points per game hour. Staff room IV is not unlocked.
statSemantics.xp: one XP per qualifying skill use; spend stamina awards one stamina XP event, not one per point; defense XP on absorbed damage; checkpoint commits adventurer XP, office rest commits staff XP

auditNotes: Synchronized with saved research table inspected 22 September 2026. Research modifiers are conditional, not baked into baseline stats.
No bear traps, fire traps, skeleton ghouls or extra chest tiers were added. Crystal is the renamed level-four chest.
Rest I uses unlock value 2/hour rather than conflicting description 3/hour. Rest II/III/IV values 3/4/5 are rates, not cumulative bonuses.
Luxury Suites explicitly repeats staff room III; staff room IV remains undefined.

Review decisions applied 22 September 2026: one-third chest success after Better basic treasure; Guild Grant pays per stat gained; final builder upgrade is tier IV; strongest spawn bonus only; no separate initial spawner price.

level_1.automaticCourse: Once per healer in town after research if affordable
